summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting routine open-market repurchases under its previously announced buy-back program (approved May 22, 2024, disclosed June 21, 2024). A broker acting for the Company bought 388,226 ordinary shares (0.04% of issued capital) on Euronext Paris during October 26-30, 2026, at a weighted-average EUR 42.0797 per share, totaling EUR 16,336,424.67. Post-period treasury holdings are 17,255,273 shares, about 1.9% of issued capital. Purchases serve employee share-option obligations under EU MAR Article 5(2). No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural event; watch only ongoing program pace and dilution offset.
